certificate_text: This is to certify that the dissertation/thesis entitled [TITLE] is a bonafide record of the research work carried out by [STUDENT_NAMES] under my/our supervision and guidance in partial fulfillment of the requirements for the award of the Degree of [DEGREE] in [DEPARTMENT] of Mahatma Gandhi University, Kottayam. declaration_text: I/We hereby declare that the dissertation entitled [TITLE] submitted to Mahatma Gandhi University in partial fulfillment of the requirements for the award of the degree of [DEGREE] in [DEPARTMENT] is a bonafide record of original work done by me/us under the supervision of [GUIDE_NAME].
